info.title: scorecard-be — consumer contract (as used by scorecard-fe)
info.description: The scorecard-be endpoints this frontend calls, with the fields it reads. Reverse-engineered from src/api/* and checked against scorecard-be routes and TECHNICAL_DOCUMENT.md §6 on 2026-11-03. scorecard-be owns the SQL and the formulas (see specs/domains/supply-chain-metrics.md). Changing a field the frontend reads means updating this file in the same PR. Validated by scripts/validate-specs.mjs (rules S12, S13).

get.summary: Sales per classification for the window
Mapping codes per classification (filters accepted but not applied, GAP-005)
Cover days per classification
Cover days for all classifications combined (one row)
Latest stock closing date (no parameters)
Benchmark days and threshold per classification in force on endDate
TP sales vs IBL target for the month of endDate
IBL target with target_date in the window (client caps endDate at today)
EFP sales vs TSCL budget for the month of endDate (one month despite the name)

parameters.description: Sent by the client but not read by the backend (GAP-010)

get.description: Sales window ends at endDate − 1 day (GAP-004).

get.summary: IBL accuracy per class per month, 3 months ending with endDate
TSCL budget accuracy per class per month, 3 months ending with endDate
IBL target vs TSCL budget per class, with a Total row
Cover days per classification × item × branch
SKU counts above/below the class threshold (classification ignored, GAP-005)
% of SKUs above threshold per branch
Threshold vs actual cover days per class
Ordered vs delivered quantity per material (branch ignored, GAP-005)
WIP orders at the latest record date in the window
Raw & packing material stock at the latest execution date
Current vs last stock upload per active RD

error.description: Detail. For bad input (4xx) the server says what is wrong. For unexpected failures the 2.0 server (BigQuery) returns only `Internal error (ref xxxxxxxx)`; the detail is in the server log under that reference (story S5). 1.0 returned the database message here.
